description:
Sign this session in to an A-Team workspace (tenant) with an API key — for a caller that holds the key OUTSIDE the chat: a local (stdio) ateam-mcp process reading it from a file, a platform proxy, a script, a self-hosted setup. A session must be signed in before any workspace operation. These need no sign-in: ateam_bootstrap, ateam_auth, ateam_get_spec, ateam_get_examples, ateam_get_workflows, ateam_spec_search, ateam_validate_skill, ateam_validate_solution.

NO KEY IN THE CHAT: the agent never asks for an A-Team key and never accepts one in the chat. If the user pastes a key anyway, do not use it (not in ateam_auth, not anywhere): tell them it is now exposed, and that a workspace owner or admin should rotate it (Tokens & Keys, in the A-Team app) before it is used again.

How a user signs in depends on how this server is connected (the hosted connector signs in in the browser, with no ateam_auth call): ateam_bootstrap's `session` field says which workspace this session is on and gives the steps that apply to it.

An A-Team key names its own API, so it needs no url (adas_prod_… → https://api.ateam-ai.com). An ADAS_API_KEY environment variable does NOT sign a session in: a key baked into a shared config could point work at the wrong workspace, so workspace tools refuse until the session signs in. For cross-tenant admin operations, use master_key instead of api_key.

api_key.description: An A-Team API key held outside the chat — never one a user typed or pasted into it. An A-Team key names its own API, so it needs no url (adas_prod_… → https://api.ateam-ai.com).

master_key.description: Master key for cross-tenant operations. Authenticates across ALL tenants without per-tenant API keys. Requires tenant parameter.

tenant.description: Tenant (workspace) name, e.g. acme. Leave it out with api_key: the key names its own workspace (ateam_auth asks the API when the key does not spell it out). REQUIRED with master_key.

url.description: Only for a host other than A-Team's own API (localhost, a self-hosted deployment), or for an older key that names no API (adas_<tenant>_<hex>, which otherwise lands on this server's default API). Leave it out for a current A-Team key: the key already names its API, and a url that contradicts it is refused.

name: ateam_auth
